value.rationale: This is a complete infinite-graph-family dynamical census, not a routine graph-size increment. A new emergence threshold for period-three oscillations at k=2, an exact orbit-count crossover at k=4, the contrasting limiting basin fractions 1/3 and 2/3, and an all-size sharp five-step transient bound describe two distinct dynamical mechanisms. The labelled orbit and basin counts are not implied by the established arbitrary-graph excitation-rate law.
